meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把不同标准的基因位置统一起来，避免分析出错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常处理基因数据，总被不同位置标注弄晕。
copy.tagline_en: Unify genomic coordinates between different formats to avoid mismatches.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic position data and often get confused by coordinate differences.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在不同坐标约定和文件格式之间换算区间,规范化并比较变异记录,核对组装版本与 contig 命名,并审计 BED、GTF、VCF 是否违反约定。换算走脚本和对照表,不凭记忆。
howto.when: 当坐标跨越文件格式、工具或组装版本边界时触发,例如提到「off by one」「liftover」「REF mismatch」等关键词,或要换算 BED/GFF/VCF 坐标、规范化 indel 时。

say.text: 把这个 BED 文件转成 GFF 坐标
say.note: 按 0-based 半开换 1-based,末尾坐标不变。

say.text: 比对这两条 VCF 记录是不是同一个缺失
say.note: 先裁剪并左对齐,再判断是否同一变异。

say.text: 检查这个 VCF 和注释文件能不能直接合并
say.note: 先核对组装版本和 contig 命名。

howto.what_en: Claude converts intervals between coordinate conventions and formats, normalises and compares variants, maps genomic to transcript/CDS/protein positions, flags assembly or contig-naming mismatches, and audits BED/GTF/VCF files.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary, including "off by one", "liftover", or "REF mismatch", or when converting BED/GFF/VCF coordinates and normalising indels.

say_en.text: Convert this BED file to GFF coordinates
say_en.note: Shifts 0-based half-open to 1-based inclusive; end unchanged.

say_en.text: Are these two VCF records the same deletion?
say_en.note: Trims and left-aligns both before comparing.

say_en.text: Can this VCF and this annotation be joined?
say_en.note: Checks assembly and contig naming first.
